definitions.bare_honorific_only: no post by (a)-(c) and the span is preceded by Mr./Señor/Sir/Baron/Count/M./Messrs
definitions.dateline_place: regex '<Capitalised place> , <Month> <d>, <yyyy>' in the first 400 chars
definitions.fromto_mentions_in_head: marked from/to spans starting in the first 300 chars of the R-0 text
definitions.office_only_correspondent: head contains 'to|from the Secretary of State|Acting Secretary of State|President|Department of State' (the correspondent is an OFFICE, often unmarked)
definitions.with_post: (a) span inside '( )' preceded (within 90 chars, after the last ' to ') by a post word; (b) a '( ... )' right after the span holding a post word; (c) a ', ...' appositive within 50 chars holding a post word. Post words: regex POST in the script.
